lede: The Gondola Leadership Committee meets Tuesday, July 28 for what looks like a real working session — background and history flagged as an action item, a walkthrough of the Capital Investment Grant program and its funding commitments, and a project update, which makes it worth watching if you care about how the gondola gets funded going forward. On Monday, Town Council sits as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive permit for July 30 at 207 N Pine — a chance to weigh in if you have thoughts. Plenty else is happening around the valley this week, from Shakespeare in the Park to the Box Canyon Races to The Music Man at the Sheridan.

notable.stake: Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit — comment is open.
Gondola funding commitments and CIG program up for action — real money, real decisions.
